label: Guided Setup
description: Guided workspace setup. Best for the baseline card flow of single answer questions, each choice carrying a hint line and a letter.

label: Multi-Select
description: Multi-select answers. Best for a flow with no card that opens on a 6 option checkbox question, its ticked count shown by the counter.

label: Write-In Answer
description: A written answer beside the choices. Best for a write-in field that clears the picked choice as you type.

label: Segmented Progress
description: Segmented progress with step names. Best for a flow whose counter is drawn as filled segments with a named step, ending on an empty state.

label: Optional Skip
description: An optional question with Skip. Best for a status badge tracking the optional middle question, which also takes a write-in, as not answered, answered or skipped.

label: Cross-Question Rule
description: A rule that sends you back. Best for a controlled step that a failed submit check moves back to the plan, with its own error copy.

label: Conditional Branch
description: A question that appears when it applies. Best for a first answer that adds a people picker step, taking the counter from 3 to 4 questions.
